categories.main_business_segments: Kyokuyo Co., Ltd. operates four main business segments: Marine Products (procurement, processing, and sales of seafood), Fresh Foods (processing and sales of sushi and sashimi, as well as fishing, aquaculture, procurement, and sales of tuna and bonito), Food Products (manufacturing and sales of frozen foods, canned foods, and seafood delicacies for both commercial and retail use), and Logistics Services (cold storage and related logistics). There is also a minor 'Other' segment, including insurance agency services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced seafood processing, freezing, and preservation technologies, as well as aquaculture techniques for tuna and other fish. It emphasizes food safety and quality assurance, with R&D focused on seafood chemistry, food hygiene, new product development (especially frozen and canned foods), production line optimization, and digital transformation (DX) in manufacturing. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports the development of novel technologies and equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kyokuyo serves a diverse customer base including food wholesalers, retailers, food service companies (such as sushi chains and restaurants), and overseas Japanese food businesses. Its products are widely distributed in supermarkets, convenience stores, and food service channels, with a growing focus on overseas markets, especially in Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan but has a significant and expanding international presence, with subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States, China, Thailand, Vietnam, Turkey, and the Netherlands. Overseas sales accounted for 10.8% of total revenue in FY2025, with a strategic goal to increase this to 15% or more.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kyokuyo operates across multiple points in the supply chain, including upstream (fishing and aquaculture), midstream (processing and manufacturing), and downstream (distribution and sales). It also provides logistics services through cold storage and transportation, supporting both its own products and third-party goods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding its business foundation, strengthening financial and stakeholder partnerships, and accelerating globalization. R&D focuses on food safety, new product development (especially value-added seafood and frozen foods), productivity improvements, sustainability (such as CO2 and plastic reduction), and digital transformation. M&A and overseas expansion are key growth drivers, alongside initiatives for workforce diversity and environmental stewardship.
categories.revenue_model: Kyokuyo generates revenue primarily through the sale of seafood, processed foods, and frozen products to wholesalers, retailers, and food service operators. Additional income streams include logistics services (cold storage and distribution fees) and, to a lesser extent, insurance agency commissions. The company does not operate a subscription or licensing model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kyokuyo is one of Japan’s leading integrated seafood and food companies, competing with major domestic and international players such as Maruha Nichiro, Nippon Suisan (Nissui), and other large food manufacturers and seafood processors. The company is positioned as a comprehensive food supplier with strengths in seafood procurement, processing, and global distribution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, Kyokuyo reported consolidated net sales of 302.7 billion yen (up 15.7% year-on-year), operating profit of 11.1 billion yen, and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 6.74 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth in both revenue and profit over the past several years, supported by overseas expansion and M&A. Total assets reached 182.1 billion yen, with a workforce of 2,476 employees (plus 2,192 temporary staff).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kyokuyo emphasizes the provision of safe, high-quality, and diverse seafood and food products, leveraging its integrated supply chain from procurement to processing and distribution. Its competitive differentiation lies in its expertise in seafood, robust quality assurance, global sourcing capabilities, and ability to develop innovative products tailored to both domestic and international markets. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability and food safety as key value drivers.
